# Specification items: scenario

| Item | Statement | Verification | Applies to | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ADV-SCENARIO-001 | A scenario file is text in which '#' starts a comment to the end of the line and blank lines are skipped; the first other line is the header time_ms,<name>,... with unique names, and every following line is a row of numbers, one per header column, whose time_ms (milliseconds of the target clock, fractions allowed) strictly increases. A header without time_ms first, a duplicate name, a row with another number of fields or a field that is not a number, a time that does not increase, a file without rows, and a file that cannot be read are refused with a message that names the file and, for a format error, the line. | unit | scenario | athrill,scenario-file of a model that reads a scenario (athrill,crsf-receiver); none (the simulator's own input format; docs/configuration.md, Scenario files) |
| ADV-SCENARIO-002 | A scenario channel has no value before the first row; from a row's time until the next row's time it has that row's value (zero-order hold), and after the last row the last value holds. The offset in milliseconds is added to every row time. A reader whose lookup time goes back searches again from the first row. | unit | scenario | athrill,scenario-offset-ms; the host value of the reading model (DEVICE_CONFIG_RC_SCENARIO_OFFSET_MS); none (docs/configuration.md, Scenario files) |
